item.title: Takamatsu Castle (Tamamo Park) — Guide
item.description: Takamatsu Castle, now the centrepiece of Tamamo Park, is one of only a handful of Japanese castles built right on the sea, its moats filled with seawater drawn directly from the Seto Inland Sea. Built by the ruling lords in the early Edo period, it was designed so that ships could sail right up to the castle, and today its wide moats are home to sea fish rather than the usual carp — you can even feed them or take a small boat on the moat.
